dedupe_keys.name: future ecological risk due to river flow alteration for the stars4water river basins

description: STARS4Water publishes near-term ecological-flow risk outputs for about 6,500 subcatchments in the Danube, Douro, Drammen, East Anglia, Messara, Rhine and Seine basins. The public README connects the results to report D2.6 and its Ecological Risk due to Flow Alteration method. It identifies two simulation scenarios and five future intervals from 2026 to 2050. The public ZIP and README are labelled CC BY 4.0 on Zenodo. River-basin modellers could use the risk classes to compare environmental-flow pressure across water-demand or climate scenarios. These are screening scores derived from changes to river-flow indicators, not observed ecological damage or a complete river-flow model. The upstream climate and flow inputs have separate provenance. The README was read but the ZIP was not opened, so subcatchment identifiers, class values and the exact scenario table remain unverified. A related later seven-basin deposit uses a 56-member climate-hydrology ensemble and different future periods; it is not a version duplicate.
name: Future ecological risk due to river flow alteration for the STARS4Water river basins
